parameters.n_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
parameters.item_type: <int> Item category determining the number and dimension ranges of items per customer.
parameters.domain_size: <int> Number of possible realizations for each stochastic item.
parameters.pct_stochastic_customers: <int> Percentage of customers whose items have uncertain dimensions and weights.
parameters.num_stochastic_customers: <int> Number of customers whose items have uncertain dimensions and weights.
parameters.recourse_cost_cf: <int> Penalty cost incurred for each customer left unserved due to packing infeasibility.

vehicle.H: <int> Height of the rectangular loading area of each vehicle.
vehicle.W: <int> Width of the rectangular loading area of each vehicle.
vehicle.Q: <int> Maximum total weight each vehicle can carry.
vehicle.K: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.

depot.id: <int> Identifier of the depot node in the distance matrix.

customers.id: <int> Unique identifier of the customer, used as a row/column index in the distance matrix.
customers.is_stochastic: <bool> Whether this customer's items have uncertain dimensions and weights.
customers.num_items: <int> Number of rectangular items to be delivered to this customer.

items.item_id: <int> Identifier of the item within this customer's order.
items.shape: <str> Shape category of the item, one of 'vertical', 'horizontal', or 'homogeneous'.
items.is_stochastic: <bool> Whether this item's dimensions and weight are uncertain.
items.num_realizations: <int> Number of possible size and weight outcomes for this item.

realizations.realization_id: <int> Identifier of this possible outcome for the item.
realizations.height: <int> Height of the item in this realization.
realizations.width: <int> Width of the item in this realization.
realizations.weight: <int> Weight of the item in this realization.

distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [n_customers+1][n_customers+1]> Travel cost between each pair of nodes, where row/column 0 is the depot and rows/columns 1 through n_customers are customers.
